title: Small-site adic strict quotient interface and canonical normalizations
statement:
Fix a module universe $\mathcal U$ as in [def-weil-size-convention]. A small-site datum $T$ consists of a category whose objects and arrows lie in $\mathcal U$ and a Grothendieck topology. A morphism $f:U\to V$ of these presented topoi is an adjunction $f^{-1}:\operatorname{Sh}(V)\rightleftarrows\operatorname{Sh}(U):f_*$ with finite-limit-preserving inverse image, together with its algebraic inverse-image lift: the induced additive and ring operations on inverse images of sheaves and their natural constant-ring identifications. For a commutative ring $A\in\mathcal U$ and ideal $I\subset A$, put $A_n=A/I^{n+1}$ for $n\in\mathbf N$, and write $\underline A_T$ for the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], $\operatorname{Mod}_T(A)$ for its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $D_T(A)$ for their ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the standard localization and K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Define $f^*$ by exact localization of the constant-coefficient module inverse image, $Rf_*$ by total right derivation of its representing right adjoint, and their adjunction by derivation of that module adjunction. Write $\operatorname{Tow}_T(A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N^{op},\operatorname{Mod}_T(A))$ [def-weil-inverse-system], realized on the small diagram site [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization], and derive this strict diagram category before evaluating. Define $G_f$ and $P_f$ by termwise inverse image and total derived termwise direct image, with their induced derived adjunction. Let $\Delta_T$ be the exact derived constant-tower functor and $\mathcal L_T=R\lim$ the total derived strict inverse limit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Its adjunction $\Delta_T\dashv\mathcal L_T$ is the unique one whose unit on every complex is the ordinary constant/limit unit followed by the universal right-derived-limit comparison.

Let $\mathcal R_T:D_T(A)\to D(\operatorname{Tow}_T(A))$ be the strict quotient reduction: on a flat-term K-flat representative [def-pc-kflat-complex] $Q$ it is the one complex of strict towers $(Q\otimes_A\underline{A_n}_T)_n$, using sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and the actual quotient transitions. Its derived completion is $C_T=\mathcal L_T\mathcal R_T$ with unit obtained from the quotient augmentation. For Noetherian $A$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], use the full derived-complete subcategory and this completion unit as in [lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction]. Define $S_{T,n}:D_T(A)\to D_T(A_n)$ to be derived scalar extension and $U_{T,n}:D_T(A_n)\to D_T(A)$ to be exact scalar restriction. The ordinary extension/restriction adjunction is uniquely normalized by insertion $m\mapsto1\otimes m$; its derived adjunction is uniquely normalized by that ordinary unit on K-flat representatives. Let $\operatorname{ev}_{T,n}$ be exact tower evaluation on ordinary and derived categories. The canonical isomorphisms are
$$\operatorname{ev}_{T,n}\mathcal R_T\cong U_{T,n}S_{T,n},\qquad G_f\mathcal R_V\cong\mathcal R_Uf^*,\qquad S_{U,n}f^*\cong f^*_{A_n}S_{V,n},$$
$$\operatorname{ev}_{V,n}P_f\cong Rf_*\operatorname{ev}_{U,n},\qquad Rf_*U_{U,n}\cong U_{V,n}Rf_{*,A_n},\qquad f^*U_{V,n}\cong U_{U,n}f^*_{A_n}.$$
The ordinary reduction/pullback comparison is uniquely fixed by commuting with quotient-unit insertions at every index; the first three derived comparisons are uniquely fixed by their whole-complex tensor and quotient-evaluation formulas on flat-term K-flat representatives, with the universal derived comparisons inserted. Evaluation/direct image is uniquely fixed on every tower complex by the equality of ordinary evaluated direct images and their universal right-derived units. Ordinary inverse image/scalar restriction is uniquely fixed by its inverse-image insertion equation; its derived version is obtained by exact localization. Direct image/scalar restriction is the adjunction conjugate of the finite scalar-extension/pullback comparison. The direct-image/limit isomorphism
$$a_f:Rf_*\mathcal L_U\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal L_VP_f$$
is the adjunction conjugate of the identity-component comparison $G_f\Delta_V\cong\Delta_Uf^*$. The finite projection
$$p_{f,n,F}:S_{V,n}Rf_*F\longrightarrow Rf_{*,A_n}S_{U,n}F$$
is the adjunct of $f^*_{A_n}S_{V,n}Rf_*F\cong S_{U,n}f^*Rf_*F\xrightarrow{S_{U,n}(\varepsilon_F)}S_{U,n}F$, where $\varepsilon$ is the fixed derived counit. Finally, $\operatorname{PerfectQuotients}(A,I)$ means that the degree-zero $A$-complex $A_n$ is perfect for every $n$, using the bounded finite-projective model predicate of [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. These are definitions of the operations and their fixed normalizations; no coefficient-exchange isomorphism or completion-mate equality is included.
